title: What counts as the general area?
question: Which of the following areas is included in the 'general area' according to the Rules of Golf? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Putting green for a different hole

explanation: The general area is most of the course, including the fairway, semi-rough and rough, and any green or teeing area for a different hole. Bunkers and penalty areas are not part of the general area.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on a fairway, pointing towards semi-rough and a green belonging to a different hole, with a visible tee area in the background.
imageAlt: A teen girl golfer on the fairway, with other greens and tee areas visible.

issues: Golfer is gripping the club right-handed, not left-handed as specified.
Golfer's top is grey rather than the required black.
Club appears visually correct (iron) with realistic proportions.
Single golf ball clearly present and realistic.
Tee markers are visible in the background; tee area present.
Course features are believable (fairway, semi-rough, green, trees, sunny weather).
Golfer's skin tone, facial features, age, and gender suit the prompt.
Clothing (bottom) is the required red color and clearly visible.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Change the golfer's grip and club orientation to clearly left-handed (right hand above left on grip, club angled appropriately). Change the golfer's top to a clearly black color.
